candidates.purpose: At each already-detected transient, explicitly select the subset of kick/snare/hihat templates that best explains the local spectrum instead of thresholding each role independently.
constraints: evaluate all 7 non-empty subsets of the 3 supported roles
choose subset by minimum BIC; no class-specific threshold
templates come only from controlled isolated fixtures D01/D02/D03 in this mechanics stage
no use of consumed independent-evaluation families
synthetic mechanics PASS cannot promote to real-easy

implementationFreeze.representation: median magnitude spectrum over 80 ms centered on annotated/detected transient
implementationFreeze.normalization: L2 per template and observed transient vector
implementationFreeze.modelSelection: BIC = nBins * ln(RSS/nBins + eps) + k * ln(nBins)
implementationFreeze.eventTime: frozen baseline transient time shared by all selected roles
